---
title: "Monthly & Seasonal Patterns (2021–2026)"
subtitle: "Compare dolphin presence across all 72 months, years, and coastal zones"
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)

dolphins <- read_csv("data/florida_dolphins_2021_2026.csv") |>
  distinct(gbif_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Complete 72-month grid (Jan 2021 - Dec 2026)
grid_72 <- expand_grid(
  year = 2021:2026,
  month = 1:12
) |>
  mutate(
    month_abb = factor(month.abb[month], levels = month.abb),
    ym_date = make_date(year, month, 1),
    is_unavailable = (year == 2026 & month == 12)
  )

monthly_all <- grid_72 |>
  left_join(
    dolphins |>
      summarize(
        fl_sightings = n(),
        sarasota_sightings = sum(region == "Sarasota Bay Study Area"),
        suncoast_sightings = sum(region %in% c("Sarasota Bay Study Area", "Tampa Bay & Charlotte Harbor")),
        .by = c(year, month)
      ),
    by = c("year", "month")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    fl_sightings = if_else(is_unavailable, NA_integer_, replace_na(fl_sightings, 0L)),
    sarasota_sightings = if_else(is_unavailable, NA_integer_, replace_na(sarasota_sightings, 0L)),
    suncoast_sightings = if_else(is_unavailable, NA_integer_, replace_na(suncoast_sightings, 0L)),
    year_str = as.character(year)
  )
```

Explore how verified visual sightings vary month by month from **January 2021 through December 2026**. Click any year in the legend to isolate or compare specific years. (**December 2026** is explicitly marked `NA` because the dataset was retrieved on November 13, 2026; acoustic detection totals are omitted because public SBLN CSV logs are restricted.)

### Year-over-Year Monthly Comparison — Sarasota Bay Study Area

```{r}
plot_ly(
  data = monthly_all,
  x = ~month_abb,
  y = ~sarasota_sightings,
  color = ~year_str,
  colors = c("#0b2545", "#137c8b", "#2a9d8f", "#8ab17d", "#f4a261", "#e63946"),
  type = "scatter",
  mode = "lines+markers",
  text = ~if_else(
    is_unavailable,
    "<b>Dec 2026</b>: Unavailable (future month)",
    paste0(
      "<b>", month.name[month], " ", year, "</b><br>",
      "Sarasota Bay Sightings: ", sarasota_sightings, "<br>",
      "Greater Suncoast (Tampa–Sarasota–Charlotte): ", suncoast_sightings, "<br>",
      "All Florida Coast: ", fl_sightings
    )
  ),
  hoverinfo = "text"
) |>
  layout(
    title = "Sarasota Bay Monthly Visual Sightings by Year (click legend to toggle years)",
    xaxis = list(title = "Month of Year"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Verified Sightings in Sarasota Bay"),
    legend = list(title = list(text = "Year")),
    hovermode = "closest"
  )
```

### 72-Month Heatmap Across All Six Years (Florida Coast & Sarasota Bay)

Hover over any cell in the 72-month calendar matrix below to see exact monthly totals, seasonal peaks (March–April and June–July), and late-summer troughs (August–October).

```{r}
heat_df <- monthly_all |>
  mutate(
    hover_txt = if_else(
      is_unavailable,
      "<b>Dec 2026</b><br>Status: Unavailable (future month)",
      paste0(
        "<b>", month.name[month], " ", year, "</b><br>",
        "All Florida Sightings: ", fl_sightings, "<br>",
        "Sarasota Bay Sightings: ", sarasota_sightings
      )
    )
  )

plot_ly(
  data = heat_df,
  x = ~month_abb,
  y = ~factor(year, levels = 2026:2021),
  z = ~fl_sightings,
  text = ~hover_txt,
  hoverinfo = "text",
  type = "heatmap",
  colors = c("#f7fbff", "#9ecae1", "#3182bd", "#0b2545"),
  colorbar = list(title = "Sightings")
) |>
  layout(
    title = "72-Month Presence Matrix (Jan 2021 – Dec 2026; gray/blank = Dec 2026 unavailable)",
    xaxis = list(title = "Month"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Year")
  )
```

### Monthly Averages & Seasonal Peaks (2021–2026)

```{r}
monthly_avg <- monthly_all |>
  filter(!is_unavailable) |>
  summarize(
    mean_sarasota = round(mean(sarasota_sightings), 2),
    mean_fl = round(mean(fl_sightings), 1),
    .by = c(month, month_abb)
  ) |>
  arrange(month)

plot_ly(monthly_avg, x = ~month_abb) |>
  add_bars(
    y = ~mean_sarasota,
    name = "Sarasota Bay Mean / Month",
    marker = list(color = "#e63946")
  ) |>
  add_lines(
    y = ~mean_fl,
    name = "All Florida Mean / Month (Right Axis)",
    yaxis = "y2",
    line = list(color = "#0b2545", width = 2.5)
  ) |>
  layout(
    title = "Average Monthly Sightings (Jan 2021 – Nov 2026)",
    xaxis = list(title = "Month"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Sarasota Bay Mean Sightings"),
    yaxis2 = list(
      title = "All Florida Mean Sightings",
      overlaying = "y",
      side = "right"
    ),
    legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.2)
  )
```
